# Getting started with Cohere: a beginner's guide

**Hook:**
By the end of this guide, you’ll understand what Cohere’s AI tools are and how to use them in your work—even if you’ve never used AI before. You’ll be ready to try a simple task in under five minutes.

## Before you start
- A free Cohere account (sign up at [cohere.com](https://cohere.com))
- A web browser (Chrome, Firefox, Edge, or Safari)
- Five minutes of quiet time

## Step 1 — Sign up and open the dashboard
Cohere gives you a simple online space to talk to AI. Think of it like a chat window where you type your questions and the AI writes back.
1. Go to [cohere.com](https://cohere.com) and click “Sign up” in the top-right corner.
2. Fill in your email, create a password, and confirm your account.
3. After you log in, you’ll land on the dashboard. Look for a button like “Start chatting” or “Go to chat” and click it.

💬 Example:
If you see a box that says “Ask anything” or “Type your message here,” you’re in the right place.

## Step 2 — Send your first message
Now you’re ready to talk to the AI. The AI understands plain English, so you can ask it anything you’d normally ask a colleague.
1. In the chat box, type:
   “Write a short welcome email for new customers.”
2. Press Enter or click the send arrow.
3. Wait a few seconds. The AI will reply with a short email draft.

💬 Example:
You can copy and paste this exact prompt:
```
Write a short welcome email for new customers. Keep it friendly and under 100 words.
```

## Step 3 — Edit the AI’s answer
The AI gives you a starting point, but you can change it to match your brand voice.
1. Read the AI’s reply.
2. If you want to shorten it, ask:
   “Make it shorter, about 60 words.”
3. If you want a warmer tone, ask:
   “Make it warmer and more personal.”
4. Keep editing until it feels right.

💬 Example:
After the AI replies, you can simply type:
```
Make it warmer and more personal.
```

## Step 4 — Save your work
You can copy the final text and paste it into your email tool (Gmail, Outlook, etc.).
1. Highlight the AI’s reply.
2. Press Ctrl+C (Windows) or Command+C (Mac) to copy.
3. Open your email app and paste the text.
4. Add your signature and any extra details, then send.

💬 Example:
You now have a ready-to-send welcome email that took less than two minutes to create.

## Step 5 — Try a business task
Cohere can help with many everyday business jobs. Pick one small task to try next.
1. Ask the AI:
   “Summarise this customer feedback in three bullet points.”
2. Paste three short sentences of feedback.
3. Read the summary and copy it into your notes.

💬 Example:
Paste this feedback:
```
The product was easy to use. Shipping took longer than expected. Customer service was helpful.
```
Then ask the AI to summarise it.

## Common mistakes
- **Over-editing**: Don’t rewrite the AI’s reply from scratch. Start with its draft and tweak it—this saves time.
- **Ignoring the prompt**: If the AI’s answer isn’t useful, check your prompt. Be specific: “Write a 50-word product description for hiking boots” works better than “Tell me about boots.”
- **Skipping the copy step**: Always copy the AI’s text before closing the chat. Once you refresh, the chat disappears.

## What this means for you
- **In everyday life**: Use Cohere to draft emails, social posts, or summaries without staring at a blank page.
- **For your business or work**: Create quick drafts for reports, product descriptions, or customer replies—freeing up time for higher-value tasks.
- **If you're just getting started**: Start with one small task, like writing a welcome email, to build confidence before tackling bigger projects.

## Try it now
Open Cohere’s chat window and type:
```
Write a 75-word product description for wireless earbuds. Make it lively and highlight comfort and sound quality.
```
Copy the reply and paste it into your notes. You just used AI to create content in under two minutes.
